name: Savanna Private Game
positioning: Privately owned tented safari lodge (Savanna Lodge) in the western Sabi Sand Nature Reserve, part of the greater Kruger National Park Conservancy
best_for: Travelers wanting suites with private heated plunge pools overlooking waterholes
Families or groups of friends booking the two-bedroom Savanna Suite

facts.text: The lodge is set within the Sabi Sand Nature Reserve, part of the greater Kruger National Park Conservancy.
From its location in the western Sabi Sand, Savanna traverses 10,000 hectares of varied terrain, from open savannah grasslands to riverine bush.
Savanna is a privately owned lodge.
The suites overlook waterholes and the savannah beyond, each set into the indigenous foliage.
The thatched Savanna Suite has two en-suite bedrooms connected by a lounge and a covered patio, with exclusive access to a private vehicle and guide when booked as a complete package.
Guests go on two game drives per day.
Sightings may include the Big Five, cheetah, wild dog, hippo, crocodile, plains game and more than 400 bird species.
A loft offers chess and a bird's-eye view of the waterhole, and the adjoining library has facilities to transfer and back up safari photographs.
There is a fully equipped gym, and in-suite massages are offered.
Young guests have a dedicated Bushbabies programme, from discovering animal tracks to bush crafts.
Rates include two game drives per day, all meals, teas and coffees, and house drinks.
Guests are welcome to visit the community and conservation projects supported by the Savanna Trust.

highlights.text: Each suite opens onto a private patio with a heated plunge pool, an outdoor shower and views of the bush.
Most of the suites have canvas-topped roofs that blend classic safari style with colonial-era elegance.
The custom-designed safari vehicles seat up to six guests and have individually heated bucket seats.
The main pool looks over gardens and a floodlit waterhole.
Nearby dams draw elephants daily in the dry winter months.

considerations.text: Children under 8 are not permitted in the main lodge; children of all ages are welcome when booking the Savanna Suite.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires advance planning.
